title: Run end
description: A run's end: how the run ended. It is not Forager's run-outcome.schema.json, the body with which a run's starter says how the run ended. It has state, and optionally reason and exit_code, the members of Forager's dev.qory.run.exited, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/events/run.exited.schema.json. This schema checks the values of reason and exit_code as that event does. The control plane reads these members from the run's dev.qory.run.exited event. A paused run has not ended; its event is not a run end. qory sets reason to say why a run failed, and $defs end_codes lists the codes that it sets, each with its cause in plain words. The list contains no advice and no action text: what each reader does for a code is the control plane's text. The list is closed in this contract and open on the wire: a reason that is not in the list passes this schema, as a newer qory may send a code that an older reader does not know. A reason in the list is valid only with state failed, so an outcome with state succeeded or cancelled and one of those codes is refused. An outcome with a member this schema does not define, such as message or action, is refused.

state.description: How the run ended: succeeded, failed or cancelled.

reason.description: Why the run ended, the reason of the run's dev.qory.run.exited: a code, a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and underscores, up to 64 characters. Any code of that pattern passes. The codes of $defs end_codes are the ones qory sets for a failed run. Forager drops a reserved reason from a starter's outcome and keeps the outcome.

exit_code.description: The run's exit code, the exit_code of its dev.qory.run.exited: the exit status of the last session, 124 when the run's time limit was reached, -1 when no session ran. An integer from -1.

end_codes.description: The end codes: the codes that qory sets in reason, each with the cause of the end in plain words. A code is a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and underscores, up to 64 characters, and none is one of Forager's reserved reasons. The causes are what happened.

oneOf.description: The run's configuration in Forager has no credential with the purpose push, so qory pushed nothing.

A push of the run's commits was refused with status 403. One of: the run's push proxy refuses a push that is not a plain push to the push_ref of the push credential; the push credential has no item for the path of the push; the forge refuses a push that the permission of the push credential or a branch rule does not allow.
The image that the build made from the target is larger than largest_prebuilt_image_bytes of the run documents, measured before qory adds its layer, so qory removes the image.

qory pushed the run's commits to the forge, and the control plane has no record of the push: the report of the push was refused with a status from 400 to 499 other than 429, or got no accepted answer in 4 sends.
The prebuild's environment image, environment_image of the run documents, is not in the registry.
The branch head at the forge is not the commit that the run expected (its start commit, or its last push), or the branch is missing.
A commit of the session changes a file that the session may not change: a file outside its plan's scope at the session's start, or any file outside .qory/ when the session has no plan.
A commit of the session adds a key or a value of the run's secrets, or the commits are too large to verify, so qory pushed nothing.
The run's documents, or the response to the run code, fail qory's validation.

The harness that the run composes, from the run documents or the target's harness file, cannot be used: its source, fetch or composition fails, neither has one, its qory version does not fit, or the runtime has no headless start for the workflow.
The machine cannot run the step: its forager.yaml, folders, home, proxies, image fit, runtime install, push verification or setup container fail, or this machine has no registry.
qory could not fetch the target of the run.
A git or folder step on the run's repository failed.
qory could not reach the forge of the run's repository.
The HEAD of the run's working folder does not descend from the commit that the run started from, so a push would not be a fast-forward.
A call from qory to the run API failed.
A prebuild failed: its build, the pull of its base image, or the push or verification of the image it built.
